verses.pali: “Accharāsaṅghātamattampi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettācittaṁ manasi karoti;
verses.english: “If, mendicants, a mendicant focuses on a mind of love even as long as a finger-snap,

verses.pali: ‘bhikkhu arittajjhāno viharati satthusāsanakaro ovādapatikaro amoghaṁ raṭṭhapiṇḍaṁ bhuñjati’.
verses.english: a mendicant who does not lack absorption, who follows the Teacher’s instructions, who responds to advice, and who does not eat the country’s alms in vain.

verses.pali: Ko pana vādo ye naṁ bahulīkarontī”ti.
verses.english: How much more so those who make much of it!”
